title: Wallet Pop-ups
intro: Ten wallet pop-ups, one minute. Some are normal, some are traps.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Sign in to Zelvora? You opened zelvora.app a moment ago. Domain: zelvora.app. Sign-in request, no funds move.
cards.why: It matches what you just did, shows the real domain and moves no funds.

cards.text: Verify you are human: sign this message to claim your reward. Domain: reward-claim.xyz
cards.why: A surprise site asking for a signature to claim a prize. Signatures can hand over control.

cards.text: Approve UNLIMITED spending of your ZLUSD for this site? Domain: swap-fast.top
cards.why: Unlimited approval from a strange site lets it empty that token later.

cards.text: Swap 50 ZLUSD for ZLX in the Zelvora app you opened. Network fee about €0.30.
cards.why: You started it yourself in a known app, a normal fee, and a clear amount.

cards.text: Your wallet is out of sync. Scan this QR code and approve to fix it.
cards.why: Support never messages first, and QR approvals can hand over your coins.

cards.text: Sign this blank message to continue. You cannot read what it does.
cards.why: A signature you cannot read is a signature you cannot trust.

cards.text: Connect to Zelvora? Read-only access, no spending. Domain: zelvora.app.
cards.why: Read-only access on the real domain that you opened yourself.

cards.text: WARNING: your wallet is at risk! Click Fix now to approve a security update.
cards.why: A scary pop-up that urges an approval. A real wallet never nags you from a web page.

cards.text: Transfer 0.5 ZLX to the address you pasted. Check the first and last characters match.
cards.why: You started it and it asks you to check the address. Do check it carefully.

cards.text: Eligible for an airdrop. Connect your wallet at zelvora-airdrop.live and approve the claim.
cards.why: A look-alike domain and a request to approve a claim.

golden_rule: Read every wallet pop-up. Never sign what you cannot read, or approve unlimited spending for a site you did not choose.

quick_check.q: A wallet pop-up from a site you do not know asks you to approve unlimited spending of your tokens. What do you do?

options.text: Approve, it is a normal step
Reject it and leave the site
Approve only if the site looks nice

quick_check.explain: An unlimited approval can let a site empty that token at any time. Reject unknown requests.
